# Emberfall Rapid Grants — draft proposal (NOT SUBMITTED)

Status: draft for Morgan to review. Deadline: 30 November 2026. Applicant must be the person accountable for the work (Morgan Hale).
Typical round size: $5k–$25k. Morgan's personal savings contribution is capped at $2,000 for the year (per Morgan's notes).

Items in [brackets] need Morgan's decision before submission.

## 1. What I will do
Halcyon Threshold is a small, independent effort to improve the odds that the arrival of superintelligent AI goes well. We are starting narrow, on work that is neglected and checkable.

Proposed 6-month project: [CHOOSE ONE]
- (a) Scoping study: map which safety-relevant questions for advanced AI have few or no people measuring them, and publish a short, sourced report with ranked gaps.
- (b) Small evals: build and publish open, reproducible evaluations for one capability or risk that current public benchmarks miss.
- (c) Rapid small grants: run a small regranting round for independent researchers, with transparent criteria.

Deliverables (for whichever option): [list 3 concrete outputs with dates].

## 2. Why me
- Accountable applicant; works evenings and weekends on this alongside a day job.
- Background: [Morgan to fill in — relevant writing, Python, research or organizing experience].
- Has begun building relationships with people in the AI safety community through local meetups and online (do not name individuals without their consent).

## 3. Budget (draft)
| Item | Amount (USD) | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Morgan's time (stipend or in-kind) | [TBD] | |
| Compute / API credits for evals | [TBD] | |
| Software, hosting, domain | ~$200 | Domain renewal $14.99/yr; hosting Pro $20/mo if needed |
| Publication / travel to meetups | [TBD] | |
| Contingency | [TBD] | |
| **Total requested** | [TBD, within $5k–$25k] | |
| Self-funded contribution | up to $2,000 | Morgan's stated cap |

## 4. Risks and what we would do about them
- Scope creep: fixed 6-month deliverables and a public changelog.
- Limited time: plan assumes ~10–15 hours/week; if that drops, deliver (a) first.
- Independence: no lab funding; disclose any conflicts. Morgan's employer's outside-role and public-statement policy is being checked with HR before any public-facing work.

## 5. Open questions for Morgan
- Which option (a/b/c)?
- Employer policy: has HR cleared applying for a grant and listing a public-facing project under your name? (The grant may be public information.)
- Final budget numbers and whether to ask for the full $25k or a smaller amount.
